scope: Indexed Flip Normals identity and normal-state correction; native equivalence is established only for the retained finite kernel controls.

nativeBasis.facetLoop: Native captured facet loop swaps triangle vertices and XORs stored facet-normal signs, then invokes vertex-normal refresh in mode zero.
nativeBasis.normalRefresh: For 41 retained original-instruction facet-plus-vertex normal captures with triangle inputs, reversing each captured triangle order before the application Flip yields exactly the captured vertex-normal Float32 bits. The first run included one isolated-vertices-only case and correctly rejected it because Flip requires triangles; it is excluded from the 41. These are controlled kernel comparisons, not an end-to-end native Flip GUI run.

guiMcp.observedRendering: Flipped surfaces displayed in the separate browser; screenshot was viewed but not retained.
guiMcp.memoryScope: Owned helper and bridge only; browser memory is outside this Job and is not included.

remaining: Native GUI comparison for the original scan and scanner-normal metadata remains open.
